title: Neon Crystal Ball
description: A large reflective crystal ball on a metallic stand displays a surreal glowing cityscape with neon pink, green, and purple buildings, palm trees, and two gondola-like boats on reflective water. Bright multicolored fireworks explode from the center with sparks and light trails against a dark room background.
prompt: A large transparent crystal ball resting on a metallic stand in a dark room, inside the sphere is a surreal fantasy city with glowing neon pink, purple and green buildings and palm trees along a canal, two wooden boats floating on reflective water, a massive burst of colorful fireworks exploding from the center with bright yellow, blue and pink light trails and sparks, dramatic lighting with reflections, painterly style
